{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the unique values in key columns
channel_unique = df['channel'].unique()
customer_segment_unique = df['customer_segment'].unique()
status_unique = df['status'].unique()
converted_unique = df['converted'].unique()

# Display results
missing_values, duplicates, channel_unique, customer_segment_unique, status_unique, converted_unique"}
